implementation.name: Example Enterprise Agent with AIS-1 v0.2

ANAGB-UI-01.notes: AIS-1 tier is displayed as an identity and accountability signal, not as a generic verified badge.

ANAGB-UI-03.notes: High-risk actions require fresh status checks and separate delegation evidence.

ANAGB-AI-05.notes: Delegation is scoped, revocable, and external to the AIS-1 bond.

ANAGB-AI-06.notes: AIS-1 bond, tier, and registry status are not represented as runtime authority.

ANAGB-A2A-09.notes: Publication includes issuance freshness, expiry, registry status, and AIS-1 v0.2 revocation handling.

ANAGB-A2A-10.notes: Clients fail safely when AIS-1 v0.2 status, parent status, or ANAB trust metadata is stale or unavailable.

standards_alignment.notes: Uses TIS v0.10 runtime assurance artifacts as evidence inputs.
Intended for evaluation under the DCAS v0.10 AIS-1 v0.2 experimental profile.
AIS-1 v0.2 is interpreted as bonded identity and accountability evidence only.
